resources.string: While charging wirelessly, StaaaaandBy fills your screen with a clock and the music you\'re playing. Just three quick steps to get ready.
This lets StaaaaandBy read the title and artwork of the song you\'re playing. Feel free to skip it — the clock works just fine on its own.
This lets StaaaaandBy appear when you place your phone on a wireless charger, or press the side key while charging.

Android may put a music app to sleep to save memory — then the song playing on another device (like Spotify on your Mac) stops showing up. For each music app below, open its settings, tap Battery, and choose Unrestricted.
No supported music app found on this phone. Install one such as Spotify or YouTube Music and it will show up here.
Off: only a wireless (Qi) charger brings up StaaaaandBy. On: a USB cable does too.
Off: only when the phone is lying sideways. On: any orientation — in portrait, the artwork slit-scans from top to bottom.
Lyric video when synced lyrics exist

Looks up time-synced lyrics on LRCLIB and plays a JIZURA lyric video in place of the slit-scan artwork. Songs without synced lyrics show the artwork as before. Tap zones stay the same: left = previous, middle = play/pause, right = next.

Follow playback through the Spotify Web API instead of the phone\'s Spotify mirror, which silently desyncs. Create an app at developer.spotify.com (Web API, Premium account), add the Redirect URI below, and paste the app\'s Client ID. Development-mode apps work for up to 5 accounts listed under User Management.
Redirect URI to register on your Spotify app:
Connected to Spotify. StaaaaandBy now follows your account\'s playback.
Enter the Client ID first (32 hex characters).
No browser could open the Spotify sign-in page.
That\'s it! Place your phone on a wireless charger and StaaaaandBy will appear. Pressing the side key while charging works too.
